documents.title: Treatment Log 2015-2025
documents.content:
2016-04-14
ID: MET-0008
Artifact: Brass Fireplace Fender
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Removed active corrosion on brass surface. Cleaned with citric acid solution, neutralized, dried. Applied protective coating of Incralac. Surface appears stable.
Materials: Citric acid solution, deionized water, Incralac.

2016-07-21
ID: TEX-0187
Artifact: Wool Coverlet
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Overall surface cleaning with vacuum. Stitched cotton muslin support to reverse of two areas with weak weave. No wet cleaning performed due to dye sensitivity.
Materials: Vacuum, cotton muslin, cotton thread.

2016-10-05
ID: FUR-0062
Artifact: Walnut Writing Desk
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Veneer re-adhesion. Lifted veneer on top surface re-adhered with hide glue and weights. Cleaned surface with mild soap solution. Waxed.
Materials: Hide glue, weights, soap solution, microcrystalline wax.

2017-02-16
ID: PAINT-0251
Artifact: Hudson River School Landscape
Conservator: R. Okafor
Treatment: Lining of canvas. Existing lining was failing. Removed old lining, applied new wax-resin lining. Surface cleaned, varnish removed, re-varnished. Losses inpainted.
Materials: Wax-resin adhesive, linen canvas, brushes, pigments, varnish.

2017-05-11
ID: FUR-0070
Artifact: Mahogany Armchair
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Loose arm rest. Re-glued with hide glue, clamped. Caster replaced on right front leg. No other damage.
Materials: Hide glue, clamps, caster.

2017-08-30
ID: TEX-0204
Artifact: Embroidered Sampler
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Humidification and flattening. Sampler was rolled, now flattened under weights. Minor losses to silk threads noted, left as is. Stitched to cotton backing for support.
Materials: Deionized water, weights, cotton backing, cotton thread.

2017-12-06
ID: MET-0015
Artifact: Silver Teapot
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Removed tarnish with silver polish. Rinsed, dried. No active corrosion. Surface appears stable.
Materials: Silver polish, deionized water.

2018-03-19
ID: FUR-0078
Artifact: Victorian Parlor Chair
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Loose seat rail. Re-glued with hide glue, clamped. Checked other joints, all tight. Finish in good condition.
Materials: Hide glue, clamps.

2018-06-15
ID: FUR-0078
Artifact: Victorian Parlor Chair
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Minor repair to carved back splat. Small crack at base of splat filled with hide glue, clamped. Touch-up of finish with shellac. No further damage noted. According to the Treatment Log, the Victorian Parlor Chair's last_treatment_date was 2018-06-15. Record status: historical.
Materials: Hide glue, clamps, shellac.

2018-09-27
ID: PAINT-0267
Artifact: Miniature Portrait, Ivory
Conservator: R. Okafor
Treatment: Surface cleaning only. Removed surface grime with saliva on cotton swabs. No other treatment performed. Condition stable.
Materials: Cotton swabs.

2018-11-14
ID: TEX-0221
Artifact: Lace Christening Gown
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Wet cleaning. Tested dyes, all stable. Washed in deionized water with non-ionic surfactant, rinsed, dried flat. Repaired small holes with nylon net and silk thread.
Materials: Deionized water, non-ionic surfactant, nylon net, silk thread.

2019-02-08
ID: FUR-0085
Artifact: Oak Library Table
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Refinishing of top surface. Existing finish was badly crazed. Removed old finish, sanded, applied new shellac and wax. Legs not refinished.
Materials: Sandpaper, shellac, microcrystalline wax.

2019-05-23
ID: MET-0022
Artifact: Cast Iron Door Stop
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Removed rust with wire brush and rust converter. Painted with black enamel.

documents.title: Treatment Log 2015-2025
documents.content:
2019-06-30
ID: PAINT-0271
Artifact: Hudson River School Oil Sketch
Conservator: R. Okafor
Treatment: Examined under raking light. Craquelure present across sky area, no lifting. Small
loss upper right corner, approx. 3mm, filled with balsa and toned with watercolor. Varnish
cloudy; left as is pending curator decision on full surface treatment.
Materials: Balsa, watercolor, tacking iron.

2019-08-12
ID: TEX-0230
Artifact: Quaker Wool Shawl
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Humidification and flattening. Shawl had been folded for years; creases deep.
Placed on blotter, humidified with damp cloths, weighted. Creases reduced but not entirely
removed. Stored rolled on tube with acid-free tissue.
Materials: Blotter, deionized water, weights, acid-free tissue.

2019-10-03
ID: MET-0031
Artifact: Brass Fire Extinguisher, ca. 1890
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Light corrosion at base. Cleaned with benzotriazole in ethanol, then coated with
microcrystalline wax. Interior not treated. Brass plug seized; not forced. Recommend
removal only by machinist if needed.
Materials: Ethanol, benzotriazole, microcrystalline wax.

2019-12-18
ID: FUR-0092
Artifact: Walnut Sideboard
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Veneer blister on right door. Re-adhered with hide glue injected under blister,
pressed with heated tacking iron. Checked all other veneer, stable. Hardware removed and
kept with object. No finish work done.
Materials: Hide glue, tacking iron.

2020-02-25
ID: PAINT-0283
Artifact: Portrait of Woman, Oil on Canvas
Conservator: R. Okafor
Treatment: Lining. Canvas had come loose from stretcher, and tacking margins were brittle.
Removed old lining, re-lined with BEVA film on new linen. Stretcher replaced with new keyed
stretcher, corners keyed out. Minor inpainting along old tacking edge.
Materials: BEVA film, linen, stretcher, inpainting colors.

2020-04-09
ID: TEX-0241
Artifact: Silk Ribbon, Civil War Era
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Surface cleaning with vacuum and brush. Ribbon is split along fold lines. No
stitching done; too fragile. Encapsulated between two layers of nylon net for support.
Housing: flat storage in folder.
Materials: Nylon net.

2020-06-17
ID: MET-0039
Artifact: Bronze Sculpture, "Bust of a Child"
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Wax coating had yellowed. Removed old wax with mineral spirits. Surface
otherwise stable. Reapplied microcrystalline wax, buffed. No active corrosion visible.
Materials: Mineral spirits, microcrystalline wax.

2020-08-28
ID: FUR-0097
Artifact: Pine Blanket Chest
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Lid hinge broken. Replaced screw, existing hinge retained. Old screw holes
filled with dowel and glue. Interior shows past insect damage, no active infestation.
Materials: Screw, dowel, hide glue.

2020-11-13
ID: PAINT-0290
Artifact: Pastel Landscape
Conservator: R. Okafor
Treatment: Surface cleaning only. Used soft brush and gentle vacuum. Pastel is friable;
no other treatment attempted. Matting replaced with acid-free mat. Glazing changed to
UV-filtering acrylic.
Materials: Soft brush, vacuum, acid-free mat, UV-filtering acrylic.

2021-01-22
ID: TEX-0252
Artifact: Wool Military Coat
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Stitched lining tear at shoulder seam with silk thread. Removed old repairs
that had caused distortion. No wet cleaning. Stored on padded hanger.
Materials: Silk thread.

2021-03-30
ID: MET-0045
Artifact: Copper Kettle
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Removed green corrosion from inside with citric acid solution, rinsed well.
Outside polished lightly. No lacquer applied. Recommend monitoring for re-corrosion in
humid conditions.
Materials: Citric acid, deionized water.

documents.title: Treatment Log 2015-2025
documents.content:
2021-06-08
ID: PAPER-0177
Artifact: Inscribed Photograph, "Harbor Scene"
Conservator: A. Novak
Treatment: Photograph had been rolled and stored in a tube. Unrolled, humidified
locally to relax creases. Laid onto a new 4-ply board using wheat starch paste.
Handling note: the inscription on the verso is in graphite and is very faint; we
did not attempt to enhance it. Housing: Mylar sleeve in a shallow box.
Materials: Wheat starch paste, 4-ply board, Mylar.

2021-09-14
ID: FUR-0112
Artifact: Oak Side Chair
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Loose rung at back. Glue joint failed. Removed old adhesive from
tenon, re-glued with hide glue, clamped. Seat is a replacement from a later
period; noted but not treated. No other structural issues found.
Materials: Hide glue.

2022-02-02
ID: MET-0061
Artifact: Brass Surveying Compass
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Removal of old lacquer, which had crazed. Surface cleaned. Brass
shows minor pitting from past use; no active corrosion. Lacquer not reapplied
per curator request to keep the surface as found. Recommend storing in
desiccated microclimate.
Materials: Acetone, cotton swabs.

2022-04-19
ID: TEX-0268
Artifact: Embroidered Waistcoat
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Stabilized loose embroidery along one front panel. Worked with
thread-by-thread couching over a support of fine silk crepeline. Lining is
fragile and shattering; left as is. Noted on condition report that the
waistcoat should be handled on a tray.
Materials: Silk crepeline, silk thread.

2022-07-30
ID: PAINT-0314
Artifact: Oil on Panel, "Portrait of a Gentleman"
Conservator: R. Okafor
Treatment: Panel had a vertical split, old repair. Re-opened the joint,
inserted new adhesive, clamped. Cradle was removed from the back; it was a
later addition and causing distortion. Filled and inpainted along the split.
Materials: Hide glue, balsa shims, gesso, inpainting colors.

2022-10-11
ID: ARCH-0033
Artifact: Parchment Deed, dated 1789
Conservator: A. Novak
Treatment: Humidified and flattened. Parchment had been folded many times;
folds are weak and one is broken. Mended with Japanese paper and wheat starch
paste on the verso. Ink is stable. Housing: encapsulated in polyester.
Materials: Japanese paper, wheat starch paste, polyester.

2023-01-25
ID: MET-0072
Artifact: Cast Iron Stove Plate
Conservator: S. Chen
Treatment: Removed heavy soot and grease with solvent gel. Rinsed. Surface
has deep pitting from firebox use. Applied a protective coat of Renaissance
wax. No attempt to hide pitting.
Materials: Solvent gel, Renaissance wax.

2023-05-16
ID: FUR-0120
Artifact: Walnut Writing Desk
Conservator: J. Whitfield
Treatment: Replaced missing brass escutcheon on top drawer. Original was
gone; used a period-style reproduction. Drawer bottom is cracked but stable.
No finish work done. Note: the desk's writing surface has a ring stain that
we did not treat; it is part of the object's history.
Materials: Brass escutcheon, small screws.

2023-08-29
ID: TEX-0279
Artifact: Printed Cotton Quilt
Conservator: M. Delgado
Treatment: Stitched a tear on the border with cotton thread. Quilt was
previously washed at some point; dyes are somewhat faded. No wet cleaning
attempted. Stored rolled on a tube with acid-free tissue in the folds.
Materials: Cotton thread, acid-free tissue.

2023-11-10
ID: PAINT-0330
Artifact: Watercolor, "Marsh Scene"
Conservator: R. Okafor
Treatment: Removed old tape from edges. Used heat to soften, then peeled.
Residual adhesive reduced with eraser. Watercolor is otherwise stable.
Re-hinged with Japanese paper and wheat starch paste. New mat and backing.
Materials: Japanese paper, wheat starch paste, eraser.
